LESSON: SIGN READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE SIGN READING: NON- FICTIOMATERIALS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Sign Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Sign Reading: Non- Fictiomaterials
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Sign Reading: Non- Fictiomaterials, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read non-fiction materials?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Sign Reading: Non- Fictiomaterials together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy is strengthened as learners read a variety of non-fiction material to inculcate a reading culture.

● Learning to Learn: Learner develops the skill of carrying out research as they search for digital and print non-fiction materials using

electronic gadgets.

Values:
Responsibility: is enhanced as learners prepare and keep a reading log of the reading activities of the non-fiction texts.

Link to other Subjects

The learner is able to relate extensive sign reading skills to their learning in Creative Arts and Sports.
